_comment: Starter catalogue for the Source Library. Every entry is created as a DRAFT with a placeholder version: nothing here is approved or usable as assessment evidence until an authorised compliance reviewer approves it. source_url values other than the RBI KYC Direction (supplied by the project owner) are best-known official landing pages and MUST be confirmed by the source owner before approval. Internal documents have no URL: upload the controlled PDF.

defaults.review_frequency: Quarterly, or when the publisher updates it

sources.title: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016
sources.description: Core India source for ML/TF risk assessment (customers, geography, products, services, transactions and delivery channels), KYC/CDD, beneficial ownership, transaction monitoring, sanctions-list screening, customer risk categories and board oversight. The assessment must be documented, proportionate and reviewed at least annually.

sources.title: RBI KYC Directions - Frequently Asked Questions
sources.description: Plain-language reference for customer-risk categorisation and implementation questions.

sources.title: RBI Notifications and Circulars
sources.description: Track changes to KYC, AML, payments, outsourcing and related risk requirements.

sources.title: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002
sources.description: Indian AML legal framework. Locate the Act on India Code and record the exact URL and amendment date.

sources.title: Prevention of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005
sources.description: Record-maintenance, reporting, CDD and related operational obligations.

sources.title: Financial Intelligence Unit - India (FIU-IND) reporting resources
sources.description: Official reporting-entity and AML reporting information.

sources.title: FATF Recommendations
sources.description: Global AML/CFT standard.

sources.title: FATF Guidance - Risk-Based Approach for the Banking Sector
sources.description: Product, customer, geography, transaction and control methodology for banks.

sources.title: FATF High-Risk and Other Monitored Jurisdictions
sources.description: Geographic-risk and country-review input. The lists change several times a year; review at each FATF plenary.

sources.title: FATF Mutual Evaluations
sources.description: Country AML/CFT effectiveness and technical-compliance context.

sources.title: FATF Guidance on Proliferation Financing Risk Assessment and Mitigation
sources.description: PF-risk and targeted-financial-sanctions assessment.

sources.title: Egmont Group - FIU intelligence and typologies
sources.authority: Egmont Group of Financial Intelligence Units
sources.description: FIU intelligence, AML/CFT typologies and strategic financial-intelligence material.

sources.title: FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual - Risk Assessment

sources.title: FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual

sources.title: FinCEN advisories and notices
sources.description: Advisories and notices on illicit-finance typologies and red flags.

sources.title: FCA Financial Crime Guide

sources.title: FCA FG18/5 - Financial crime systems and controls guidance
sources.description: FCA finalised guidance on financial-crime systems and controls.

sources.title: EBA Guidelines on ML/TF Risk Factors
sources.description: Detailed customer, country, product, service, transaction and delivery-channel risk factors. Capture the Guidelines PDF itself.

sources.title: EBA guidance on restrictive measures
sources.description: EBA guidance on internal policies, procedures and controls for restrictive measures.

sources.title: FINTRAC risk assessment guidance
sources.authority: Financial Transactions and Reports Analysis Centre of Canada

sources.title: OFAC - A Framework for OFAC Compliance Commitments
sources.authority: U.S. Department of the Treasury - Office of Foreign Assets Control

sources.title: OFAC Sanctions List Search
sources.authority: U.S. Department of the Treasury - Office of Foreign Assets Control
sources.description: U.S. sanctions screening and research. A list match is an alert for human investigation, never a final sanctions decision.

sources.title: OFAC guidance on instant payment systems
sources.authority: U.S. Department of the Treasury - Office of Foreign Assets Control
sources.description: Relevant to cross-border payments scenarios. Locate the guidance PDF on the OFAC site and record its exact URL.

sources.title: United Nations Security Council Consolidated List
sources.description: UN targeted sanctions screening. A list match is an alert for human investigation, never a final sanctions decision.

sources.title: UK Sanctions List and OFSI guidance
